P.name: An Acquired Taste
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tahm Kench's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|5 to 60 for 12}}|magic damage}} ({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health}}) {{as|(+ 4% of his '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''An Acquired Taste'' against enemy {{tip|champions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.67}} seconds when the duration ends.
P.description2: ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' and ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' gain additional effects against enemies with 3 stacks, consuming them all.

Q.name: Tongue Lash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' lashes his tongue in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them by 50% for 2 seconds. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Tahm Kench''' also {{tip|heals}} himself.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 255}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} + [ {{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench|icononly=true}} {{pp|5 to 60 for 12}} {{as|({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health)|hp}} {{as|(+ 4% '''bonus''' health)}}}} ]}}
{{st|Heal|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5 to 7}}% of '''missing''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' can be cast during ''Tongue Lash'' at no cost to pull the target to '''Tahm Kench''' before swallowing them.
Q.description4: '''''Tahm Kench''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move, attack, or cast {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} or {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} on a different target while his tongue is in flight. Tongue Lash's range and travel speed can be increased by '''Tahm Kench's''' {{tip|size}}.''

W.name: Abyssal Dive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|1.35}} seconds as he dives into the waters to emerge at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area during the channel.
W.description2: Upon completion of the channel, '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location after a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. If at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} is hit, 40% of ''Abyssal Dive's'' {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost as well as a percentage of its {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.
W.description3: ''Enemies can see the indicator for '''Tahm Kench's''' destination after he has channeled for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, if they have {{tip|sight}} of the area. '''Tahm Kench''' remains {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.65}} seconds after the blink.''

E.name: Thick Skin
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tahm Kench''' stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased while there are at least 2 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions either dead or alive. He can store up to {{as|300% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
E.leveling:
{{st|Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|15 to 47}}%}}
{{st|Increased Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|42 to 50}}%}}
E.description2: While ''Thick Skin'' is not on cooldown, and after 4 seconds without taking damage, '''Tahm Kench''' rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to restore {{pp|key=%|60 to 100}} of the amount, {{tip|healing}} for {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' converts his current [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

R.name: Devour
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' abducts the target {{tip|champion}}, {{tt|pulling them|See notes}} to him over the cast time and then swallowing them to carry them in his belly for up to 3 seconds. While inside, the target is {{tip|attach|attached}} to '''Tahm Kench''' and is rendered {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|displacement immune}}. ''Devour'' can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of ''{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}}''.
R.description2: If the target is an ally, they become {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and are granted a {{tip|shield}}, which decays in strength by 50 every {{fd|0.25}} seconds after they are ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench|Regurgitated}}''. '''Tahm Kench''' will also gain {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 3 seconds and is unable to cast movement spells besides ''{{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}'' while an ally is inside of his belly.
R.description3: After 1 second, '''Tahm Kench''' can cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' while a target is inside of his belly, and automatically does so after the duration. The swallowed ally can also {{tt|input a movement command|RMB}} to force '''Tahm Kench''' to cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' in a target direction of their choice, unless they are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} during ''Devour's'' cast time and while attached. '''Tahm Kench''' will also be {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% under those same conditions.
R.description5: ''If '''Tahm Kench''' is performing {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}, {{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}} will not automatically cast until after he finishes {{ais|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} effects.''

R.name: Regurgitate
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' detaches the swallowed champion from himself and {{tip|airborne|spits}} them out in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to them at the end of the displacement.
R.description2: '''''Tahm Kench''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after casting Regurgitate. If Regurgitate was cast automatically, '''Tahm Kench''' spits the target out in his facing direction.''
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 400}} {{as|(+ 15% {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
